doc: Reward v5 (owner 2026-11-02): an episode is a fixed number of in-game days (run_skill_env --days), not one life. Death is penalised and play goes on after the respawn; every day survived is paid; progress = entries of the progress list (src/rl/progress-list.json) reached within the episode, judged by the environment from server statistics. Unit: 1.0 = one progress entry. Kills and mined blocks are no longer paid (they were the dirt/wood loops of runs 3-6); they reach the learner through the progress list only.

survival.doc: Paid at each dawn of the episode if the bot did not die since the previous dawn (or the episode start). Slept = in a bed when the night was skipped.

death.doc: Per death (the bot respawns at its episode site with an empty inventory; keepInventory false). A bot the stuck detector finds trapped is killed by the environment and pays this too: hiding in a pit must not be a way to collect days (run 1).

progress.doc: Per progress-list entry, the first time it is reached in the episode.

invalid.doc: Owner 2026-11-01: a command that cannot be executed scores negative, by its reason. Failures the policy did not cause (died, disconnected, cancelled, internal) are free.

stages.doc: Weights per reward term, applied by the learner to reward_terms (the environment sends every term unweighted). One stage: the episode objective itself.
